projectsData.title: Mi ISTPET — Student Mobile App (Google Play)
projectsData.description: Official mobile app published on Google Play Store. Digitized the student ID card with a dynamic QR code and includes schedules, grades, and real-time push notifications.
projectsData.longDescription: Official academic mobile platform built with React Native Expo (New Architecture – Fabric) and a .NET 8 backend using Clean Architecture and CQRS. Gives the student and faculty community access to a secure digital ID card via offline HMAC-SHA256 signatures, grades, and schedules.
projectsData.problem: PVC credentials prone to forgery and wear, recurring printing costs, and no official mobile channel to check live schedules and grades with offline validation at campus entry points.
projectsData.decision: Built the app with Expo SDK 54 / React Native and a .NET 8 Web API. Designed a QR card token signed with HMAC-SHA256, allowing entry validation without depending on a constant internet connection.
projectsData.tradeoff: Offline validation required synchronizing symmetric keys and timestamps with a tolerance window on the entry scanner.
projectsData.impact: Published on Google Play Store; replaced the physical PVC card for the student community and reduced recurring printing costs.

projectsData.title: ISTPET Graduation System — Defenses & Records
projectsData.description: Comprehensive platform for degree applications, faculty committee assignment, defense scheduling, and records with Angular 22 and .NET 8.
projectsData.longDescription: Core system built under strict Clean Architecture in .NET 8, with a decoupled Angular 22 frontend (zoneless, using Signals and a hexagonal Ports & Adapters architecture). Manages the full graduation cycle, from validating academic prerequisites to grading and issuing the degree certificate.
projectsData.problem: Manual committee-assignment process with frequent scheduling conflicts among faculty, delays validating requirements, and a lack of traceability in defense records.
projectsData.decision: Implemented a clean architecture with strict layer separation: backend with CQRS, MediatR, FluentValidation, and permission-based authorization (`[HasPermission]`); frontend with reactive Signal-based stores and decoupled HTTP ports.
projectsData.tradeoff: Initial learning curve implementing hexagonal architecture on the frontend, offset by isolated unit tests and low coupling between layers.
projectsData.impact: Notably reduced the time spent scheduling graduation committees and automated the issuance of degree records.

projectsData.title: Institutional Welfare — Scholarships & Agreements
projectsData.description: Platform to digitize scholarships, payment agreements, and academic follow-up, built with Angular 21, .NET 8, and Word/PDF document generation.
projectsData.longDescription: Institutional web system built in Angular 21 (Signals, standalone components) and ASP.NET Core 8 Web API over MySQL 5.7 (SIGAFI). Automates scored evaluation of scholarship applications, installment payment agreements, and dynamic generation of official resolutions with MiniWord and QuestPDF.
projectsData.problem: Manual evaluation of hundreds of scholarship applications with physical files, delays drafting official resolutions, and no tracking of payment agreements.
projectsData.decision: Designed a socioeconomic scoring engine (60% vulnerability / 40% academic merit weighting) with automated generation of `.docx` and `.pdf` documents from institutional templates.
projectsData.tradeoff: Generating documents on the server with MiniWord and QuestPDF instead of the client, to keep seals and legal formatting immutable.
projectsData.impact: Considerably reduced scholarship processing time and made it possible to generate official resolutions in one click instead of drafting them by hand.

projectsData.title: GAcad — Academic Management & Scheduling ERP
projectsData.description: Core web system for institutional schedules, faculty workload distribution, and automatic detection of class-schedule conflicts.
projectsData.longDescription: Modernization of the institution's academic core, built in Angular 21 and .NET 8 Web API with background jobs via Hangfire and centralized authentication using RSA public keys (AuthGlobal).
projectsData.problem: Faculty schedule conflicts and classroom overbooking during semester planning, plus delays validating professors' teaching-load hours.
projectsData.decision: Developed a matrix validation engine in C# .NET 8 that checks in real time for collisions between professors, student groups, and physical classrooms.
projectsData.tradeoff: In-memory, runtime matrix validation to keep response times fast against recurring queries.
projectsData.impact: Eliminated schedule overlaps in faculty workload distribution and notably reduced the time spent building the institutional schedule.

projectsData.title: GRECUH — HR & Credentialing System
projectsData.description: Web platform for labor contracts, digital employee files, and high-resolution faculty credentials with SkiaSharp and SharePoint integration.
projectsData.longDescription: Comprehensive HR system built in Angular 20 (PrimeNG + TailwindCSS) and a .NET 8 backend with Entity Framework Core Code First. Manages semester faculty contracts, digital archiving on the institution's SharePoint cloud, and PVC ID rendering with SkiaSharp.
projectsData.problem: Scattered management of physical faculty contracts, slow manual generation of institutional ID cards, and no secure digital repository for faculty records.
projectsData.decision: Implemented a solution that automates contract drafting, connects to Microsoft SharePoint for document archiving, and uses the SkiaSharp library in .NET 8 to generate 300 DPI ID cards with barcodes.
projectsData.tradeoff: Native server-side graphics rendering (SkiaSharp) requires precise pixel calibration, but produces print-ready PVC cards without extra design software.
projectsData.impact: Considerably reduced the time to consolidate faculty contracts and automated the issuance of institutional IDs.

projectsData.title: Scorecraft — Sports & Medical Platform (CDMI)
projectsData.description: Web platform for physical monitoring, injury history, anthropometric measurements, and player statistics.
projectsData.longDescription: Comprehensive system built in Angular and .NET Core to centralize records for the coaching staff, physical trainers, and medical department of the sports club.
projectsData.problem: Medical records scattered across physical spreadsheets, with no correlation between physical fatigue and match performance.
projectsData.decision: Built a reactive Angular dashboard with a C# backend and a relational database, with automated anthropometric index calculations and Chart.js visualizations.
projectsData.tradeoff: Strict digitization of medical records ahead of every competitive matchday.
projectsData.impact: Centralized the player roster's medical records and injury tracking in one place.

projectsData.title: DebtManager — C# Desktop Finance Software
projectsData.description: Native C# .NET desktop app with locally encrypted SQLite for financial control, loans, and amortization, fully offline.
projectsData.longDescription: Desktop tool focused on user privacy and a fast response. Includes amortization table simulators (French and German methods), financial charts, and local persistence.
projectsData.problem: Constant internet dependency and privacy concerns with cloud-based finance platforms for managing collections.
projectsData.decision: Implemented a native C# solution with an embedded SQLite database engine and LINQ queries optimized for a near-instant response.
projectsData.tradeoff: Desktop software with no cloud, prioritizing speed and data ownership over the convenience of cloud sync.
projectsData.impact: Fast financial calculations, full portability in a lightweight executable, and fully offline debt tracking.

projectsData.title: AvialB / SIAT — Offline-First Traffic Investigation
projectsData.description: Offline-first mobile and web ecosystem for field traffic-accident reporting with asynchronous sync.
projectsData.longDescription: Hybrid app built with Ionic, Angular, and C# for traffic investigators who need to gather technical evidence in rural areas or roads without mobile coverage.
projectsData.problem: Loss of cellular connectivity at accident sites and slow transcription of expert reports originally taken on paper.
projectsData.decision: Designed an offline-first architecture with an on-device local database and background sync through work queues once a connection is detected.
projectsData.tradeoff: Custom conflict-resolution and asynchronous queueing logic was needed to preserve the integrity of forensic evidence.
projectsData.impact: Digitized expert reports directly at the accident site with geolocation, notably reducing delivery times.

projectsData.title: RPG Journey — Java OOP Game Engine (Swing)
projectsData.description: Turn-based role-playing game built in pure Java with Swing, demonstrating inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces, and collections.
projectsData.longDescription: Decoupled design between the logic model (`com.rpg.logica`) and the graphical presentation (`com.rpg.gui`). Includes classes like Warrior, Mage, Rogue, Tank, and Support/Healer with dynamic polymorphism and custom painting for status bars.
projectsData.problem: Designing an extensible turn-based combat engine without coupling the visual interface to the damage-calculation formulas.
projectsData.decision: Applied a dedicated special-action interface, abstract classes for characters, and LIFO (`Stack`) structures for the loot inventory.
projectsData.tradeoff: More structured classes in exchange for being able to add new character classes without touching the graphical interface.
projectsData.impact: A functional, instructional project that illustrates pure OOP principles in Java.

projectsData.title: Recursive OOP Minesweeper (Java Desktop)
projectsData.description: Native desktop game applying OOP and a recursive flood-fill algorithm on 2D matrices with state control.
projectsData.longDescription: A mathematical implementation of the classic Minesweeper that manages random mine distribution, adjacent-cell calculation, and cascading reveals through recursive calls.
projectsData.problem: Handling the expansion of empty cells on the board without freezing the UI.
projectsData.decision: Structured the logic around 2D matrices with a bounded recursive depth-first search algorithm and Swing event handling.
projectsData.tradeoff: Native Swing interface with no external libraries, for maximum portability.
projectsData.impact: Instant response and clean code for teaching purposes in algorithms.
